This show has been in slow news mode for 6 of the last 6 episodes. This may indicate stale RSS sources, an overly aggressive content tracker, or insufficient source diversity. Consider:

  - Expanding slow news segments: shows/segments/omni_view.json
  - Checking content tracker cooldown settings
